data.name: 魔法之境 Magic Realm
data.detailed_description:
The game supports four languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese.

     Magic Realm is a narrative-driven breakout roguelike game full of fantasy and adventure. Players will take on the role of the young mage Sistaya, journeying together with her friend Yinghuo to explore uncharted territories in a mysterious magical world. To realize their shared dream, you will step into the perilous Misty Forest and uncover the ancient magical secrets hidden within the castle. The game blends magical combat, a potion system, and difficult choices. Players will face monsters, mysterious magical artifacts, and the conspiracies lurking behind them. With wisdom and courage, you will determine the direction of the story and lead your companions toward a bright future. Are you ready for this adventure full of magic and challenges?

      The main gameplay of Magic Realm's combat section is a breakout-like game. We have incorporated multiple core mechanics such as: parry mechanism, skill combinations, character development system, and potion system. Each system is interlinked, forming a unique combat system with extremely high freedom. In this way, even in the same boss battle, every player can have their own unique solution.

A total of 8 skills and 16 potions are available for combination!

(If you don't like the breakout gameplay, you can also skip it directly to experience the story!!)    You can easily mow down enemies by combining single-target or AoE skill builds, ricochet builds, melee builds, mana-burn builds, and potions!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences, including: fantasy/mild violence; violent acts; accidental death; bodily injury; violence description; killing; torture; detailed deaths; depiction of violence acts; fear; psychological horror; mild swearing; unapproved use of medical drugs; some nudity or sexual content; sexual humor; non-explicit sexual content, prostitution, exaggerated eroticism or excessive erotic content (such as focusing on body parts in a dance, striptease, etc.).

For those who may feel discomfort against the listed topic(s), please refrain from playing the game.

Explanations regarding some of the topics listed above:

Unapproved use of medical drugs:
All potions and magical brews appearing in this game are fictional items within a fantasy world. They serve as basic props within a magical setting, capable of enhancing various character abilities and restoring magical power. Any depictions resembling hallucinations are manifestations of the characters' unique abilities within the game's fictional world. They are not intended to depict or encourage the use of illegal drugs or psychotropic substances in the real world and contain no negative guidance.

Blood; violent acts; bodily injury; corpses; violence description; killing; detailed deaths; depiction of violence acts; fear; psychological horror; mild swearing:
As part of the game's darker world-building experience, this game contains depictions of violence, including murder scenes. Most violent content is presented through text descriptions or indirect visual hints. As the story progresses, some violent imagery is presented directly. However, violence and gore in the game are primarily presented through text or stylized, non-realistic imagery to minimize psychological impact on players while maintaining the game's atmosphere.

Some nudity or sexual content:
This game contains partial nudity resulting from combat damage to character outfits, as well as scenes with suggestive undertones and mild language within the storyline. However, there is no explicit depiction of genitalia or pornographic intent. Any nudity or sexual content in the game is primarily presented through text or stylized, non-realistic imagery to minimize psychological impact on players while maintaining the game's atmosphere.

Sexual humor:
Includes playful remarks about the body figures of certain characters, without insulting intent, accounting for a very small proportion of the overall story.

Non-explicit sexual content, prostitution, exaggerated eroticism or excessive erotic content (such as focusing on body parts in a dance, striptease, etc.):
Only includes descriptions and playful remarks focusing on body parts, accounting for a very small proportion of the overall story.

This game is set in a fictional fantasy magic world. All characters and place names appearing in the game have no relation to the real world.
